d: The US is talking about a possible deal with Iran, even as military strikes continue. The explosions on Iran’s Qeshm Island on November 2 have raised fresh questions about Washington’s strategy. According to US media reports, American forces had been carrying out limited strikes against Iran for several weeks. Meanwhile, Donald Trump and JD Vance have expressed optimism about negotiations, while reports suggest that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu wants the US to resume major strikes after the midterm elections.
